title: Joktan
summary: Son of Eber and brother of Peleg (Gen 10:25); father of thirteen sons whose dwelling was "from Mesha ... unto Sephar a mount of the east" (Gen 10:30).
description: Son of Eber and brother of Peleg (Gen 10:25); father of thirteen sons whose dwelling was "from Mesha ... unto Sephar a mount of the east" (Gen 10:30). Josephus (Antiquities I.6.4, Whiston): "These inhabited from Cophen, an Indian river, and in part of Asia adjoining to it."
